Darius = the Mede who with Cyrus conquered Babylon, not Darius I or III; Jerome declines to choose and reports the views of Africanus (Artaxerxes' 20th year, lunar years, to Christ), Eusebius (two schemes: high-priestly "christs" from Cyrus; from Darius's 6th year to Herod/Hyrcanus), Hippolytus (last week at the end of the world), Apollinaris (from Christ's birth; future rebuilding), Clement (Cyrus to Vespasian), Origen (seek the data), Tertullian (Darius's first year to Christ's birth and to Vespasian) and "the Hebrews" (Vespasian and Hadrian)
